使用实数权重时也显示弗里德尔对: Also show the Friedel pair for real-valued weights
元素权重可以是实数，或含实部和虚部的 JSON 对象。下例为用于比较相位的常数标: An elemental weight can be a real number or a JSON object with real and imaginary parts. This example uses constant scalars to compare phases.
输入条件以这些标量为准。实际共振散射可依赖能量和偏振。: The calculation uses these scalar inputs. Actual resonant scattering can depend on energy and polarization.
使用复数格式的权重时，结果自动显示成对反射。: With complex-format weights, the results show the pair automatically.
两条反射都消光，无法定义相对强度差。: Both reflections are extinct, so the relative intensity difference is undefined.
结构振幅的实部: Real part of the structure amplitude
结构振幅的虚部: Imaginary part of the structure amplitude
两条反射有相同的晶面间距。粉末谱在同一个角度收集两条反射的强度。: The two reflections have the same plane spacing. Their intensities contribute at the same angle in the powder pattern.
scatteringFactors 必须为最多 64 项的元素→散射权重对象: scatteringFactors must map elements to scattering weights, with at most 64 entries.
复散射权重必须恰好包含 re 和 im 两个实数分量: A complex scattering weight must contain exactly two real components, re and im.
f 为恒定标量散射权重。复分量为示意输入，未代入随波长和散射矢量变化的表值。: The scattering weights f are constant scalars. The complex components are illustrative, while tabulated values depend on wavelength and scattering vector.
I=|F|² 为运动学结构因子强度。粉末棒谱按等 d 汇总两向贡献。张量散射、偏: I=|F|² is the kinematic structure-factor intensity. The powder sticks sum both directions at equal d. Tensor scattering, polarization, thermal motion, absorption, broadening, and texture require additional models.
仅枚举 |h|、|k|、|l|≤ZXQD0DQXZ，独立计算每个 ±hkl 对的: The range is |h|, |k|, |l| ≤ ZXQD0DQXZ. Each ±hkl intensity is calculated separately and added to the same powder stick.

用同一片石英比较 110、101 的强度差，再核对反演与合并粉末峰。: Compare the 110 and 101 intensity differences in the same quartz structure, then check inversion and the combined powder peak.
